shot.continuity: one take, camera moving in every segment, never locked off
shot.framing: vertical, the brightest lit surface fills the lower half — counter until 8.6 s, lit floor after

subject.character: plump grey tomcat in a black top hat and waistcoat behind a marble bank counter, mic at his mouth
subject.physicality: heavy soft body, half-lidded eyes, deadpan, grooms himself the instant something goes wrong, smiles only in the final beat
subject.anti_action: stacks coins into perfect towers at blinding speed, belly wobbling, counter creaking
subject.consistency: same cat, same hat and waistcoat; only the hat leaves his head and returns

environment: night bank hall, white marble counter, rouble coins, brass lamp, rain on the window
lighting: hard brass lamp over the white marble — the marble is the brightest surface, its light spills onto the floor so the last beat is lit just as brightly. Cold blue window rim one side, warm brass rim the other

audio.delivery: fast, clipped, bored deadpan, male voice
audio.pacing: three lines back to back with no gap at 0.6-1.6, 1.6-2.1, 2.1-3.5. Last word done by 3.5 s; after that the cat says nothing, mouth shut

timeline.a: slams a paw flat on the marble at the lens, coins jump and clatter. Silent
timeline.cam: lens at counter level, marble ramps up to white

timeline.a: spoken fast. Claws a coin out of the marble, the effort tipping him sideways
timeline.cam: pushes in from paw to face

timeline.a: spoken fast, no pause. Slaps his paw over the coin, the counter shudders
spoken fast, straight after the last line. Rakes the whole spill of coins to himself
mouth shut from here on. Stacks the coins into towers at blinding speed, face unmoving
timeline.cam: cranes into top-down over the towers, turning

timeline.a: a pigeon crashes onto his shoulder, wings wide, rips a coin off — the tower topples
timeline.cam: cranes low, the wing chopping the lamp beam across the marble

timeline.a: grooms a paw in fast licks, eyes on the gap. Behind him the tower keeps collapsing, coins rolling to the floor. The pigeon leaves frame with its coin
timeline.cam: drifts in on his face, lamp shadow crossing

timeline.a: takes the hat off and lowers it to counter level, brim flat on the marble
timeline.cam: tracks the hat down to the counter

timeline.a: rakes every coin along the marble straight into the hat, coins pouring in
timeline.cam: follows the paw and the pouring coins

timeline.a: puts the loaded hat back on his head and smiles once — the only smile
dissolves into a puff of smoke and is gone, counter empty
timeline.cam: keeps drifting as smoke lights up in the beam

timeline.a: the loaded hat drops through the smoke, bounces off the counter and rolls across the lit floor, coins spraying
timeline.cam: cranes to floor level, following the hat

timeline.a: the pigeon hops to the last coin on the floor, takes it in its beak and flies out of frame
timeline.cam: pushes in low on the pigeon as it lifts off

negative_prompt: any speech after 3.6 seconds, pause between the lines, drawn-out delivery, coins thrown away from him, hat staying on the counter, a second cat, duplicate props, floating objects, dim scene, underexposed, dark foreground, locked-off camera, slow camera move, big round eyes, cute, kawaii, grinning through the take, any lettering in frame, subtitles, watermark, English speech, extra limbs, horizontal framing
